verdict.rationale: Simular documents a public Sai API that developers can call from their own code or coding agents. It lists concrete endpoints: POST /v1/agents/message to send a task, GET /v1/agents/events to stream progress, and POST /v1/agents/approve to answer approval requests. A Python SDK (`pip install sai-sdk`) and an MCP server wrapper back this up. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, but that only shows no machine-readable spec was found; it does not contradict the documented API. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, documentation of authentication and rate limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of the API working as described.
